name: value-change
title: Value Change
description: An inline before → after diff of one value: the old value struck in a del, a muted arrow, the new value in an ins, with a spoken "changed from A to B".

meta.whenToUse: One field's old and new value in an activity feed, audit log, impact review or version note.
meta.whenNotToUse: Comparing whole texts or documents (DiffView), or a number's trend (Stat).
